verdict.summary: A typical small AI-agent startup is unlikely to qualify for public Spotify distribution. Broad distribution needs Extended Quota Mode, Spotify’s approved public-access mode. New requests need a legally registered organization, an active launched service, and at least 250,000 monthly active users. Spotify also assesses market availability, commercial viability, and policy compliance.
verdict.activeEffort: About 4–6 hours for the listed registration, configuration, and test steps. Review preparation and submission add time.
verdict.waitTime: Up to 6 weeks, possibly longer during peak periods [official and community-reported]
verdict.mainGate: Public distribution requires Extended Quota Mode. New requests require a legally registered organization, an active launched service, and at least 250,000 monthly active users.

recommendation.text: Use Authorization Code with PKCE for each customer's Spotify connection. Use a protected backend if your web app can safely store a client secret. Do not plan public launch until Spotify grants Extended Quota Mode, meaning broad app distribution.

sources.quote: Use the Authorization Code with PKCE flow … for any user-specific data.

The authorization code flow with PKCE is the recommended authorization flow if you’re implementing authorization in a mobile app, single page web apps, or any other type of application where the client secret can’t be safely stored.
Apps in this category can be installed by an unlimited number of users and the allowlist in development mode no longer applies.

scopeTiers.text: Read the current player state only. This is the lowest access tier for a music assistant.

sources.quote: Read access to a user’s player state.
Spotify's app review team will take a look at your app and evaluate it for compliance with our Developer Policy .

scopeTiers.need: Read the user's current playback state.

scopeTiers.text: Read saved music and playlists. This still needs app-level Extended Quota review for public distribution.

sources.quote: Request only the minimum scopes … needed for the features being built. Do not request broad scopes preemptively.
Spotify's app review team will take a look at your app and evaluate it for compliance with our Developer Policy .

scopeTiers.need: Read saved music, private playlists, and collaborative playlists.

scopeTiers.text: Create playlists, save music, or control playback. These actions increase user risk, but Spotify publishes no separate scope-review tier.

sources.quote: Manage your private playlists.
Write access to a user’s playback state
Control playback on your Spotify clients and Spotify Connect devices.
Spotify's app review team will take a look at your app and evaluate it for compliance with our Developer Policy .

scopeTiers.need: Create or edit playlists, save music, and control playback.

essentials.text: Access tokens last 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 6 months. Refreshing access does not extend refresh expiry. On invalid_grant, delete the refresh token and reconnect the user.

sources.quote: Access tokens are intentionally configured to have a limited lifespan (1 hour)
Refresh tokens issued to apps registered in the Developer Dashboard have a lifetime of 6 months.
Refreshing an access token does not extend the refresh token's lifetime.
Your app should discard the refresh token and start the appropriate authorization code flow instead of retrying the refresh request.

essentials.text: Register an exact callback URL. Production callbacks need HTTPS. Local testing must use http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://[::1]:PORT, not localhost.

sources.quote: The value of redirect_uri here must exactly match one of the values you entered when you registered your application, including upper or lowercase, terminating slashes, and such.
Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address, when HTTP is permitted.
localhost is not allowed as redirect URI.
If you are using a loopback address, use the explicit IPv4 or IPv6, like http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://[::1]:PORT as your redirect URI.

essentials.text: Development Mode allows up to 5 authenticated users. Add each user to the allowlist before testing. The app owner needs an active Premium subscription.

sources.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode
Each Spotify user who installs your app will need to be added to your app's allowlist before they can use it.
If the owner's Premium subscription lapses, the app will stop working. It will resume functioning once the owner resubscribes.

essentials.text: Rate limits use a rolling 30-second window. Spotify publishes no universal request count. On 429, wait for Retry-After before retrying.

sources.quote: Spotify's API rate limit is calculated based on the number of calls that your app makes to Spotify in a rolling 30 second window.
The header of the 429 response will normally include a Retry-After header with a value in seconds.
Endpoints are grouped into quota buckets and requests to endpoints in the same bucket count toward a shared limit. The specific groupings and limits are subject to change.

essentials.text: No Web API, quota-extension, certification, or production-tier price appears in the researched sources. Web API use requires Spotify Premium.

sources.quote: Note: You need a Spotify Premium account to use the Web API.
The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

essentials.text: Public distribution needs Extended Quota Mode. New requests require a legal organization, a launched service, and at least 250,000 monthly active users.

sources.quote: Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals).
Established Business Entity (legally registered business or organisation)
Operating an active, and Launched Service
Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

essentials.text: In Dashboard Settings, open Quota extension Request. Complete the 4-step questionnaire and submit. Spotify says review can take up to 6 weeks.

sources.quote: Tap on the Quota extension Request tab Tell us about your app by filling out the provided questionnaire (4 steps) Tap Submit
This review process can take up to six weeks.

essentials.text: Secure Spotify content, personal data, tokens, and third-party AI services. Publish a privacy policy. Let users disconnect and delete their personal data afterward.

sources.quote: Prior to using the Spotify Platform, you must have in place industry standard security and protections for any Spotify Content
You are also responsible for the security measures used by third parties providing services to you.
You must provide a privacy policy which clearly describes how you intend to access, use, process and disclose user data.
you agree to delete and no longer request or process any of that user’s personal data.

requests.text: Send the user here and verify the returned state value matches RANDOM_STATE.

sources.quote: const authUrl = new URL("https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize")

code_challenge_method Required Set to S256 .
code_challenge Required Set to the code challenge that your app calculated in the previous step.
state Optional, but strongly recommended This provides protection against attacks such as cross-site request forgery.

requests.label: Send the user to sign in

requests.text: Exchange the callback code using the original PKCE code verifier.

sources.quote: const url = "https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token";

requests.label: Exchange the code for tokens

requests.text: Refresh tokens expire after 6 months and are not extended by refreshes.

sources.quote: const url = "https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token";
Refresh tokens issued to apps registered in the Developer Dashboard have a lifetime of 6 months.

requests.label: Refresh the access token

detail.text: In the Developer Dashboard, select Create an App. Enter an app name and description. Accept the Developer Terms to create the client ID.

sources.quote: To create an app, go to your Dashboard and click on the Create an App button
Enter an App Name and App Description … put a tick in the Developer Terms of Service checkbox and finally click on CREATE

detail.text: Add your exact production HTTPS callback in the app settings. Add a literal loopback IP callback for local testing. Do not use localhost.

sources.quote: localhost is not allowed as redirect URI.
Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address, when HTTP is permitted.

steps.title: Draft the OAuth callback

detail.text: Use a session-bound state value and reject a callback with a mismatched state. For a mobile app, single-page app, or another client that cannot safely store a client secret, use Authorization Code with PKCE and retain one verifier per connection. For a protected backend that can safely store the client secret, use the Authorization Code flow. Exchange the callback code at POST /api/token and securely bind returned tokens to the user.

sources.quote: code_challenge_method Required Set to S256 .
If there is a mismatch then your app should reject the request and stop the authentication flow.
It can do this by sending a POST request to the /api/token endpoint.

detail.text: Select only the scopes used by the first release. Start read-only where possible and add write scopes only for an explicit user action. Update the authorization request so its scope parameter contains only the selected scopes; do not request the full read-and-write sample scope set by default.

sources.quote: Request only the minimum scopes … needed for the features being built. Do not request broad scopes preemptively.

detail.text: In the Dashboard allowlist, add each tester before they connect. Development Mode supports up to five authenticated Spotify users, so add only the testers you need, up to that limit. Ensure the app owner has an active Premium subscription.

sources.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode
Each Spotify user who installs your app will need to be added to your app's allowlist before they can use it.

detail.text: Encrypt stored tokens. Refresh access tokens before expiry. Ask the user to reconnect before six months and after invalid_grant. Replace the refresh token when Spotify returns a new one.

sources.quote: Build reauthorization into your app before refresh tokens expire.
When a refresh token is not returned, continue using the existing token.

detail.text: Use backoff after every 429 response. Wait for the Retry-After seconds value. Paginate search results above 10 during Development Mode.

sources.quote: The header of the 429 response will normally include a Retry-After header with a value in seconds.
If your app relies on fetching more than 10 results per search request, you will need to paginate through results using the offset parameter.

steps.title: Prepare policy disclosures

detail.text: Review and publish this disclosure in your privacy policy. Add a working disconnect control and deletion job. Do not use Spotify data to train or ingest an AI model.

sources.quote: you must provide all users with an easily accessible mechanism to disconnect their Spotify account from your SDA at any time
using the Spotify Platform or any Spotify Content to train a machine learning or AI model or otherwise ingesting Spotify Content into a machine learning or AI model;

steps.output:
Privacy disclosure draft:
We use Spotify data only to provide your requested music features. We store connection tokens securely. You can disconnect Spotify at any time. After disconnection, we stop processing and delete your Spotify personal data. We do not train, fine-tune, embed, or build models from Spotify content.

detail.text: Apply only if the applicant is a legally registered organization with an active launched service and at least 250,000 monthly active users. Submit the application from a company email through Dashboard Settings → Quota extension Request. Spotify also assesses availability in key markets, commercial viability, and compliance with its terms and policies.

sources.quote: Application must be sent through a company email by using this form .
Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

detail.text: Spotify reviews your submission, tests the app, and emails feedback. Answer follow-up questions promptly. Peak periods can take longer than six weeks.

sources.quote: The app review team will review the information that you have provided, test out your app and send you feedback by email
This review process can take up to six weeks.
During peak periods, it may take longer than six weeks.

detail.text: Only after approval, verify the app has Extended Quota Mode. Then allow customers outside the development allowlist to connect.

sources.quote: Apps in this category can be installed by an unlimited number of users and the allowlist in development mode no longer applies.

detail.text: Monitor throttling, token failures, disconnect requests, and third-party AI providers. Stop processing and delete Spotify personal data after a user disconnects.

sources.quote: you agree to delete and no longer request or process any of that user’s personal data.
You are also responsible for the security measures used by third parties providing services to you.

gotchas.text: A user can finish login but still receive 403 API errors in Development Mode. This applies when that user is not on the app allowlist.

sources.quote: API requests with an access token associated to that user and app will receive a 403 status code error.

gotchas.text: Do not automate plays or follows. This applies to any bot, script, or automated process using Spotify.

sources.quote: This includes: (i) using any bot, script or automated process;

gotchas.text: Do not create listening profiles or derived audience metrics. This applies whenever your product analyzes Spotify content or service use.

sources.quote: Do not analyze the Spotify Content or the Spotify Service for any purpose, including without limitation, creating new or derived listenership metrics

gotchas.text: Do not rely on Development Mode for a business. This applies even if five test users can use the app.

sources.quote: Development Mode provides a sandboxed environment for learning and experimentation. It is intentionally limited and should not be relied on as a foundation for building or scaling a business on Spotify.

whenBlocked.text: If Extended Quota is unavailable, keep the integration limited to five allowlisted test users. Build other music-provider paths until your organization meets Spotify's eligibility requirements.

sources.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode
Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

whenBlocked.text: If review rejects the app, correct the policy or design issue and resubmit through Quota extension Request. A resubmission can begin another six-week review target.

sources.quote: If your request is rejected and needs to be resubmitted, an SLA of another 6 weeks will be applied after resubmission.

whenBlocked.text: If review is delayed, ask in the Spotify Developer Community. Do not contact unrelated Spotify teams for escalation.

sources.quote: you can find help in the Spotify Developer Community . Here, you can connect and get help from other developers.
It will not help a developer to try to reach out to other Spotify teams to get their request expedited or a question answered.
